name: Air Royale
summary:
Air Royale delivers exhilarating aerial combat, redefining the action genre. Players will soar through an open space, engaging in fast-paced fights that demand both skill and strategy. Intuitive controls and dynamic movement create an accessible yet deep gameplay experience, where mastering flight is just as crucial as aiming. A unique upgrading system adds a strategic layer to the action. Download Air Royale now!
